name: I.C. Medical Inc.
old_description: provides increased surgical site visibility for your surgeons while reducing accidental fluid and tissue suction.
about:
I.C. Medical Inc. is headquartered in Phoenix, Arizona. The company traces its origins to 1983, when Ioan and Elena Cosmescu emigrated from Romania and settled in Phoenix. Six years later, the couple launched I.C. Medical, establishing a business focused on surgical smoke evacuation. Ioan Cosmescu, a biomedical engineer and inventor, and Elena Cosmescu, a registered nurse and hospital administrator, brought deep healthcare experience to the venture.

Today, I.C. Medical develops and manufactures a range of surgical smoke evacuation devices, including the Crystal Vision® filtration system, the Telescopic PenEvac® and Non-Telescopic PenEvac® electrocautery pencils, as well as filters, sensors, and accessories. All products are produced, assembled, tested, and quality-assured in-house at the company’s 60,000-square-foot manufacturing facility in Phoenix. The operation maintains total control over design, engineering, component sourcing, precision manufacturing, and packaging.

The company’s devices are used in surgical operating rooms worldwide, serving hospitals and surgical teams. I.C. Medical’s PenEvac® pencils are compatible with major smoke evacuator brands such as ConMed, Buffalo Filter, Stryker, Neptune, and Zimmer Biomet. The Crystal Vision® system is designed for open surgical procedures, while the PenEvac® line captures smoke at the source during electrosurgery.

I.C. Medical emphasizes its in-house production model as a differentiator, citing the risks of quality fade associated with outsourcing. The company holds 53 U.S. patents and more than 59 international patents for its smoke evacuation technologies. Its quality system is subject to regular audits by the FDA, ISO, CE, and CSA, and all products are made in the United States using virgin raw materials and proprietary processes.
